summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for incoming bot reviews (CodeRabbit and Copilot), automatically resolve them, then collect staging performance baselines for the vault login path before a vault migration lands.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads across 4 rounds were resolved with real bug fixes committed; staging performance baselines were captured; a session restore race condition was discovered, documented, fixed in PR #350, and merged.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed — functions return Uint8Array directly, not a named type
recovery.html was using the vault key IPNS name for root folder traversal (single name where two distinct names were needed)

The Axios 401 interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts already deduplicates refresh on 401 responses, but direct calls to authApi.refresh() from session restore effects are NOT deduplicated by it
TEE republishes IPNS records every 3 hours, so IPNS record expiry for the vault key blob is handled by the TEE — not the client
Web3Auth Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates total login time (~9-45s); our vault-critical path is <1.5s
The staging DB was wiped, so no existing vaults existed for baseline measurements — required creating a fresh vault via wallet login
E2E tests use @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for real secp256k1 signing in Playwright

code.finding: Broad try/catch wrapped both getVault() and downstream IPFS calls — a 404 from any IPFS fetch would incorrectly trigger vault initialization for an existing user. Fixed by giving getVault() its own try/catch.

After PR #349, existing vault login path resolves vault key IPNS name; if that record is missing the function throws 'Vault key IPNS name not found', which the session restore catch block handles by logging out Core Kit
authApi.refresh() had no deduplication — multiple React effects on page reload would fire 6 concurrent refresh calls. Fixed with a module-level shared Promise.

initializeOrLoadVault useCallback needed module-level deduplication guard — concurrent callers from session restore + normal login flow both called it, leading to double vault init and duplicate key constraint violation on folder_ipns table
Used slice() which copies buffer — should be subarray() for zero-copy view
sequence=0 conflict on IPNS publish should abort (return error) rather than warn-and-continue

workflow: The /loop skill + CronCreate provides an effective automated PR review monitoring pattern — cron fires every 5 minutes, triggers /resolve-pr-reviews when unresolved threads are detected
Outside-diff-range review comments don't appear as unresolved GraphQL reviewThreads — they require manual discovery by fetching the review body directly
Playwright MCP browser_run_code sandbox doesn't support Node module imports (dynamic import fails) — standalone .mjs scripts run via Bash are more reliable for complex automation
Native Playwright page.on('request'/'response') events are more reliable for network monitoring across navigations than injected fetch interceptors
markdownlint runs in CI on all files, not just staged files — prettier/lint issues in test scripts can block CI even when unrelated to the main fix

friction: GitHub GraphQL API timed out on one polling cycle — transient network issue, handled gracefully
Copilot outside-diff-range comments don't surface as unresolved reviewThreads in GraphQL — required manual user intervention to flag them
OTP-based Web3Auth login can't be automated via Playwright on staging — required switching to wallet login with mock provider injection
window.ethereum mock injection must happen before page load via addInitScript, not after navigation
Playwright MCP browser_run_code doesn't support Node imports, requiring a fallback to standalone Bash scripts
fetch monitoring via injected window.fetch override doesn't survive page navigations
No existing vaults on staging (DB wiped) initially blocked realistic IPNS/IPFS latency measurements
prettier CI check runs on all files including test scripts — staging-perf-wallet.mjs failed lint requiring a follow-up fix commit
open_items: Post-deploy re-measurement: run tests/web-e2e/staging-perf-wallet.mjs against staging after PR #349 deploys to get real IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch numbers for the v2 key blob path
Session restore baseline remains incomplete — Core Kit tKey shares don't persist across Playwright browser contexts, so true session restore (tab reopen within session lifetime) wasn't measurable
Auth/refresh race condition fix (PR #350) needs E2E test coverage for the session restore path to prevent regression
The duplicate vault init race was traced to concurrent React effects — consider adding an integration test that simulates rapid double-mount of the auth hook
CodeRabbit stopped reviewing after the first round of fixes — unclear if this was intentional or a bot configuration issue worth investigating
